title: Export selected salesman commission evidence page to Excel
description: Users download the currently selected field order and current preview page as Excel using a dedicated export endpoint that rebuilds fresh bounded authorized evidence from the request, never posted rows or a preview cache. Reuse preceding DTO/rules/service and NPOI already referenced by the solution; add a narrow DynamicSalesCommissionExcelExporter helper in Infrastructure with direct construction from the controller (no new DI registration/package/config). Numeric known signed original-currency values and counts retain numeric cells; null amount/profit/rate/payout are explicitly unknown, configured zero rate remains numeric zero but labelled current reference only. Always include normalized dates/filters/page coverage/source count and cap/current-user restricted approved-order source/current-reference-rate and unknown historical-profit/payout explanations even context fields unselected. No full-match or cross-currency total and no appended unselected employee detail columns; escape formula-like untrusted employee/context strings as literal cells, keep text and numeric distinctions. Existing page downloads Excel with current selection/filter/page, preserving state and showing permission/overflow/export failure without stale download. Use existing HTTP OperationLogMiddleware audit without writing duplicate business records. Development only. Reuse existing sales-commission menu, current-user SalespersonDataScopeService customer scope, approved nondeleted SalesOrders and OperationLogMiddleware HTTP audit; each endpoint rechecks identity, menu and fresh scope and validates the current request, failing closed without data/file on revocation, invalid input or source overflow. Salesman filters are order attributes and never expand customer scope. Current parameter rate is reference information, not a historical agreed rate, actual payout, customer agency fee or ledger entry. No client identity/scope/rows/aggregates as authority, arbitrary/model-generated SQL, business writes, new domain entities or persistence schema, migrations, schema/view/stored-procedure changes, production SQL or real database execution, credentials/secrets/.env/config changes, irreversible operations, production deployment or real browser acceptance. Preserve unrelated modules and uncommitted work. Run focused in-memory service/API/export and UI source-contract tests plus configured safe Release build/test; unavailable external database/browser acceptance is environment-blocked, never fabricated passed.
acceptance_criteria: Excel endpoint revalidates current selection/page/filter and fresh identity/menu/customer scope, rebuilding the same bounded page without trusting client rows or stale previews.
Excel workbook preserves selected column order, signed numeric values, explicit unknowns and mandatory evidence context with formula-safe literal strings and no unsupported totals.

Existing page downloads Excel with current state and explicit failures; workbook/controller/UI tests cover revocation, caps, negative/unknown/zero values and formula-like labels, and safe build/test pass.
